# OpenReview MCP Server

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for interacting with OpenReview.net API v2.

## Core Capabilities
- **Area Chair (AC) Tools**: Bidding, list assigned submissions, get review status reports, identify missing reviews, and send bulk reminders.
- **Reviewer Tools**: Bidding (list papers, place bids), list assignments, track discussion updates, and monitor venue deadlines.
- **Author Tools**: List and track own submissions, retrieve visible feedback (reviews/comments).
- **General Tools**: Venue discovery (list/search), submission search, and detailed note retrieval.

## Usage Guidelines
- **Discovery**: Start by listing or searching for venues to get the `venue_id`.
- **Context**: Use `get_profile` to identify your own roles and ID within a venue.
- **Safety**: Always use `dry_run=True` (default) when using `send_bulk_message`. Confirm with the user before sending actual emails.
- **Security**: 
  - NEVER attempt to read or expose `.env` files or other secret-bearing files.
  - NEVER attempt to read or expose environment variables containing credentials (e.g., `OPENREVIEW_PASSWORD`).
  - If credentials are missing, ask the user to provide them in their local environment instead of reading them from disk.

## Tool Reference
- `get_profile`: Get current user info.
- `list_venues`: Find active conferences.
- `get_ac_submissions`: List papers assigned to you as AC.
- `get_review_status_report`: Check review progress for your papers.
- `send_bulk_message`: Email reviewers/authors (supports `reply_to`, `invitation`, `signature`, `parent_group`).
- `get_reviewer_emails`: Obtain preferred emails (unmasks via logs if `venue_id` is provided).
- `get_group_members`: Member IDs of any readable group (e.g. a `Reviewer_xxxx` handle -> `~Name1`; `Reviewers` -> anonymous group IDs).
- `get_profiles`: Display name and preferred email for a list of `~Name1` IDs (generalizes `get_profile`).
- `get_reviewer_candidates`: Reviewer candidates for one paper, ordered by affinity, with the numbers the assignment browser shows (affinity score, assignments, custom max papers, pending reviews, availability) and the browser's availability/pending/quota filters; optional recent paper titles. Read-only.
- `assign_reviewer`: Assign a pool reviewer to a paper (the browser's Assign button; TMLR). `dry_run=True` by default: runs all checks and shows the edge, writes nothing. Refuses on conflict, unavailable, pending reviews, at quota, already assigned, or not in the pool.
- `unassign_reviewer`: Remove a reviewer's assignment (undo of `assign_reviewer`); `dry_run=True` by default; refuses if the reviewer already posted a review.
- `submit_review_approval`: TMLR Action Editor's Review Approval (`Appropriate for Review` / `Desk Reject`). `dry_run=True` by default; editorial and irreversible, so only post after the user explicitly chooses. Papers stay at `Assigned_AE` (no reviewer assignment possible) until it is submitted.
- `get_ac_updates`: Get new reviews/comments for papers you chair (supports `since`).
- `get_reviewer_updates`: Get new comments/rebuttals for papers you review (supports `since`).
- `get_author_updates`: Get new feedback for your own papers (supports `since`).
- `get_discussion_updates`: See recent comments/rebuttals.
- `get_server_time`: Check OpenReview server clock for drift synchronization.
- `get_inbox_summary`: Get a dense, token-efficient summary of all recent activity in assigned forums.
- `get_bidding_info`: List papers available for bidding and current user bids.
- `place_bid`: Submit or update a bid for a paper.
- `get_bidding_status`: Summary of bidding progress in a venue.
- `download_submission_attachments`: Download attached files (rebuttals, supplementary materials, etc.) for a specific submission by forum URL or ID.
- `download_batch_attachments`: Batch download attachments (e.g., all rebuttals) across assigned papers.
- `download_batch_pdfs`: Batch download PDFs for assigned papers.
- `skills/openreview-ac-*` (Claude Code Agent Skills, packaged by `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`): venue-setup (collect this venue's guidelines into venue_profile.md), sync (dump/diff/PDF text/dashboard), dossier (verbatim-quote concern ledger with rebuttal status and PDF fact-checks), messages (plan_wave.py plans, subagent drafts with claims files, mechanical verify plus independent fact-check, approval-gated sending via send-plan/gate/log-sent), metareview (verbatim TL;DR, then refine the AC's own draft).
